action_categories.definition: Reads or displays substantive existing textual content from a file or bounded region.
exclude: Text or symbol matching as the primary operation; use SEARCH_TEXT.
Path enumeration or path predicates; use LIST_PATHS or SEARCH_PATHS.
Opening or attempting to read a named path without substantive content; use ACCESS_FILE.
include: Reading source, headers, scripts, configuration, patches, changelogs, logs, or textual excerpts.
Using a command whose primary effect is emitting existing text.
